grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTENTSAI, CAB.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, CAB.VLRNOTA, (CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN 'Venda' ELSE 'Compra' END) AS TIPMOV FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE CAB.DTENTSAI <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN AND CAB.DTENTSAI >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI AND CAB.TIPMOV IN (/*'V',*/'C') AND CAB.CODEMP = 501 UNION ALL SELECT C.NUNOTA, C.NUMNOTA, C.DTENTSAI, C.CODPARC, P.RAZAOSOCIAL, C.VLROUTROS AS VLRNOTA, (CASE WHEN C.TIPMOV = 'V' THEN 'Venda' ELSE 'Compra' END) AS TIPMOV FROM TGFCAB C INNER JOIN TGFPAR P ON C.CODPARC = P.CODPARC WHERE C.TIPMOV IN ('C'/*,'V'*/) AND C.VLROUTROS > 0 AND C.CODEMP = 1 AND C.DTENTSAI >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI AND C.DTENTSAI <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN
